summary: Comprehensive backend (24 pytest tests, 100% pass) + frontend (all critical flows green) testing of Nosh Focus Cycles v1. Auth cookies, role gating, business rules (DRI self-rating block, non-contributor block, DRI-only reflection), CRUD on cycles/objectives/plans/updates/reflections/feedback/manager-review all work. UI: Login, Dashboard, Cycles, Objective detail tabs, MyPlan, Weekly Update, Reflection (individual + DRI toggle visible only for DRI), DRI Feedback, Manager Review (4 tabs), Admin Users page — all render and wire up correctly. Role-based sidebar hides manager/admin links from contributor.

minor.issue: Any authenticated user (including contributors) can list all users — emails/names/roles exposed. Probably intentional for DRI-picker UX, but consider restricting sensitive fields or gating behind manager+ if privacy needed.

issues: Objectives list only appears after async load — UI shows no skeleton/loader so feels blank for ~500ms after navigation. Auto-select of first cycle works correctly.

action_items: Consider restricting GET /api/users to manager/admin (or returning only id+name for non-admins) to avoid leaking full user directory to contributors.
Optional: add a loading skeleton on Cycles/Objective detail to avoid brief empty state.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 735-line file — fine for v1 but should be split into routers/{auth,cycles,objectives,plans,updates,reflections,feedback,manager_review}.py once more features land.
Cookies use SameSite=None + Secure — correct for cross-site preview URL. CORS uses explicit origin + allow_credentials=True. Good.
bcrypt hash format verified via successful login after seed → $2b$ format implied by bcrypt.gensalt().

seed_if_empty is idempotent for users but cycle/objectives only seed once (count_documents == 0). Admin password is NOT re-hashed if ADMIN_PASSWORD env changes — seed does not update existing admin. Minor.
All endpoints use /api prefix and exclude `_id`. UUIDs used consistently.
No brute-force lockout implemented (playbook calls for 5-fail lockout). Not in problem statement for v1 but flag for future.
JWT_SECRET read from env (good). Access token 12h, refresh 7d — reasonable.
Pydantic validation catches invalid enum values (verified: invalid weekly status returns 422).
seed_data_creation: Used seeded cycle + 2 seeded objectives. Tests created TEST_-prefixed cycles/objectives/plans/updates/reflections/feedback/manager-reviews but did not clean up (v1 tolerable; can add teardown later).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py at /app/backend/tests/test_nosh_backend.py is the regression suite. 24 tests covering auth, cycles, objectives, plans, updates, reflections, feedback, manager-review, plus role/business-rule guards. Run: pytest backend/tests/test_nosh_backend.py -v. Frontend smoke-tested via Playwright for all 4 roles (contributor/dri/manager/admin).
rca of the issue: No bugs found — all requested features operate per spec.
